commands.command: set -e; EXPECTED=7ac1a19c20787a5dc05db55baf1c7e3412c520f5; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); REMOTE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}'); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL remote=$REMOTE; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$REMOTE" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; echo pre_call_state=$(state); test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2-bidir-raw-install.log; cat /tmp/phase2-bidir-raw-install.log; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; set +e; echo '=== prepare-abort-offcall ==='; A=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe prepare-abort-offcall" 2>&1); AE=$?; printf '%s\n' "$A"; echo prepare_abort_exit=$AE; echo '=== start-offcall ==='; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe start-offcall" 2>&1); BE=$?; printf '%s\n' "$B"; echo start_offcall_exit=$BE; set -e; echo post_call_state=$(state); test "$(state)" = "0"; rm -f /tmp/phase2-bidir-raw-install.log; echo phase2_bidirectional_offcall_raw_complete=true
